title: Open Mic Night @ Barleycorn's
event_description: Join us every Wednesday for open mic night featuring all genres of music from solo acts to full bands. Acoustic music and original performances welcome.
backline: Full PA system - monitors - 18 inputs with 6 monitor mixes
event_venue_information:
About Barleycorn's

Barleycorn's is a nationally revered live music venue located just outside historic Old Town in Wichita. Since opening its doors - this intimate venue has become a cornerstone of the local music scene - showcasing original music from local - regional - and national acts.

Music Programming

The venue hosts live music Thursday through Saturday nights with Wednesday reserved for open mic. Sunday nights feature acoustic open mic sessions. All shows are 21+ and the venue has a capacity of 155 seated or 240 standing.

Venue Features

With professional sound equipment including Behringer x-18 mixer - Peavey mains - and multiple monitors - Barleycorn's provides excellent sound quality. The venue offers daily drink specials including half-priced drinks on Thursdays. Monday evenings feature trivia nights.

title: Open Mic Night @ Fairmount Coffee
event_description: Monthly open mic night on the first Friday of every month featuring musicians with instrumental and vocal performances. Family-friendly event in a cozy coffeehouse setting.
event_venue_information:
About Fairmount Coffee Co.

Fairmount Coffee Co. is a community-focused coffeehouse located just south of Wichita State University on 17th Street. Launched as an outreach of Fairmount Ministries - it provides a welcoming space for the university and community to gather.

Music & Events

The venue features live music - open mic nights - and Final Friday shows on weekends. Open mic nights are held the first Friday of every month and are family-friendly events welcoming all musical styles and spoken word.

Atmosphere

With locally roasted coffee - fresh baked goods - and made-to-order food - Fairmount Coffee offers a cozy atmosphere perfect for studying - working - or enjoying live performances. The space is open Monday-Friday 7am-7pm and Saturday 8am-5pm.

title: Monday Open Jam @ Kirby's Beer Store
event_description: Open mic and jam session every Monday night. All musicians welcome in this dive bar setting. Free show featuring local talent across all genres.
event_venue_information:
About Kirby's Beer Store

Kirby's Beer Store has been a cornerstone of Wichita's underground music scene since 1972. This no-frills dive bar is a legendary music venue known for hosting raw - energetic performances in an environment that welcomes everyone.

Live Music

The venue hosts live music any night of the week with Mondays reserved for open mic and jam sessions. All shows are free and start at 10 PM unless otherwise noted. With both indoor and outdoor stages - Kirby's offers intimate gigs and outdoor concerts.

Venue Amenities

Next door is Kirby's Flipside - a retro-inspired pinball arcade with vintage machines. The bar features super reasonably priced drinks and personable bartenders. Special events include the long-running Goth Nite (25+ years) and the annual MeatFest music festival.

event_venue_information:
About Wichita Blues Society Jams

The Wichita Blues Society hosts monthly blues jams that have become a cornerstone of the local blues community. These all-ages events evolved from guitar workshops that began in 2011.

Jam Format

The jam is free and open to all ages. Music is not limited strictly to blues - vocalists and brass musicians are encouraged to attend. Local blues musicians are on hand to share blues fundamentals and mentor young players.

What to Bring

Depending on what you play - jammers should bring a small amp and drum sticks. The venue provides bass amp - drum set - and keyboard. High-hat and cymbals if you prefer your own. The goal is to share blues with young people and show how blues fundamentals help with many music styles.

title: Jazz Jam @ Walker's Jazz Lounge
event_description: Regular jazz jam sessions hosted at Wichita's premier jazz club. Features local jazz musicians with opportunities for sit-ins and improvisation.
event_venue_information:
About Walker's Jazz Lounge

Walker's Jazz Lounge is Wichita's premier jazz club - founded by father-and-son duo Gary and Walker Jones. The venue celebrates the rich tapestry of jazz in Wichita's cultural scene.

Live Music Programming

The lounge hosts live jazz performances Thursday through Saturday evenings from 5pm to midnight. Tuesday nights are reserved for jazz performances. The venue features both established local jazz legends like Josué and Jim Pisano - as well as up-and-coming talent.

Venue Experience

With elegant ambiance - handcrafted cocktails - and charcuterie boards - Walker's creates unforgettable jazz experiences. The venue offers both ticketed shows and jam sessions. Special events include Final Friday Blues presented by Wichita Blues Society and monthly bluegrass sessions.

title: Jazz Night @ Mort's Martini Bar
event_description: Tuesday night jazz performances on the patio during spring and summer. Features local and regional jazz artists in an upscale martini bar setting.
event_venue_information:
About Mort's Martini & Cigar Bar

Located in historic Old Town - Mort's has been serving Wichita since 1996. Known for its impressive menu of over 160 unique martinis - the venue also features live music up to 7 nights a week.

Music Schedule

Tuesdays are reserved for jazz performances. Live music is featured on the heated and cooled patio during spring and summer months. In fall and winter - shows move inside with solo and duo acoustic acts.

Atmosphere

The venue offers half-price martinis on Mondays - complimentary jalapeno popcorn - and an extensive selection of cigars. With a full bar and exceptional service - Mort's has become a staple of Wichita nightlife for over 25 years.
